name: Integration for HubSpot – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor, Gravity Forms and More
author: Plugcrux

sections.description:
This plugin sends form submissions from Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Forms, Gravity Forms, and Formidable Forms to HubSpot CRM.

When a user submits a form, the plugin can create or update records (Contacts, Companies, Deals or Tickets) in your HubSpot CRM account. This helps reduce manual data entry and keeps your HubSpot data in sync with your website forms.

Supported form plugins:

  • Contact Form 7
  • WPForms
  • Elementor Forms
  • Gravity Forms
  • Formidable Forms

Authentication

To connect your HubSpot CRM account:

  1. Go to Settings > Connections in the plugin.
  2. Click Add connection.
  3. Enter an identifiable account name (for example, “Main HubSpot CRM Account”).
  4. Click Authenticate to open the HubSpot authorization page.
  5. Log in to HubSpot and approve the requested permissions.
  6. After approval, you will be redirected back to WordPress, and the connection will be listed under Settings > Connections.

Add Integration

Adding an integration is a three-step wizard:

  1. Form and destination: enter a name, choose the form (Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Forms, Gravity Forms or Formidable Forms), the HubSpot connection and the HubSpot object (Contacts, Companies, Deals or Tickets). Test connection and Refresh from HubSpot are available.
  2. Field mapping: map form fields or custom values to HubSpot properties.
  3. Record action and filters: choose a record action and optionally filter which submissions are sent.

Use Test run to check an integration before saving, then click Save.

Logs

The plugin provides a logs section to review how data is being sent to HubSpot CRM.

  • Open the Logs page to see a list of submissions and their statuses.
  • Statuses:
    • Success – the record was sent to HubSpot.
    • Failed – the record was not sent because of an error (for example, a required field is missing).
    • Skipped – the submission was not sent because of the integration’s filter conditions or its record action.

Additional options:

  • Filter logs by integration, status, or date range.
  • Open the log details view to see the full HubSpot response, including note and attachment results.
  • Resync failed records one by one or in bulk.

Settings

Global settings can be managed from the Settings page:

  • Delete data on uninstall – when enabled, all plugin data will be removed when the plugin is deleted from WordPress.
  • Error email notification – enable or disable email notifications when a record fails.
  • Notification emails – specify one or more email addresses (comma-separated) to receive error notifications.
  • Email subject – set the subject line for error notification emails.

External services

This plugin connects to HubSpot to send your form submissions to your HubSpot CRM account.

HubSpot API (https://api.hubapi.com) and HubSpot sign-in (https://app.hubspot.com)

  • Used to: connect your HubSpot account (OAuth sign-in), load objects and properties, run Test run, and send form submissions and resyncs.
  • Data sent: the mapped form field values (for example email, name, company, notes, attachments) and the HubSpot account authorization.
  • Terms of Service: https://legal.hubspot.com/terms-of-service
  • Privacy Policy: https://legal.hubspot.com/privacy-policy

Privacy and Data Handling

  • We do not collect any data from your site or your visitors.
  • Form submission data is sent only to HubSpot.

Features

  • Connect supported form plugins to HubSpot CRM
  • Unlimited connections and integrations
  • Contacts, Companies, Deals and Tickets
  • Map standard and custom HubSpot properties, custom values and system fields (page URL, entry time, UTM values, location)
  • Record actions: Always add as a new record, Skip if the record exists, Add or update, Update only
  • Notes added to the HubSpot record
  • File attachments
  • Conditional filters
  • Test run
  • Logs with Success, Failed and Skipped statuses and the full HubSpot response
  • Resync of failed records one by one or in bulk
  • Email notifications for failed records
  • Option to delete all plugin data on uninstall

Support

If you need help or want to request a feature:

  • https://integrazo.com/pages/contact
  • https://integrazo.com/pages/request-feature

Website: https://integrazo.com
Email: support@integrazo.com

Additional Notes

This plugin supports WordPress multisite installations and has been tested for compatibility with recent WordPress versions.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
2. In the search bar, type Integrazo and locate this plugin.
3. Click Install and then Activate.
4. Go to the plugin settings to connect your HubSpot CRM account and start syncing.

Manual installation
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
2. Activate the plugin.
3. Go to the plugin settings and complete the setup.
sections.faq:
Which WordPress form plugins does this support?

This plugin currently supports:

  • Contact Form 7
  • WPForms
  • Elementor Forms
  • Gravity Forms
  • Formidable Forms

How do I integrate Contact Form 7 with HubSpot CRM?

  1. Open the plugin and go to the Setup tab.
  2. Choose Contact Form 7 as the form type.
  3. Select the HubSpot CRM object (for example, Contacts).
  4. Map the Contact Form 7 fields to HubSpot CRM fields.
  5. Save the integration.

How do I integrate WPForms with HubSpot CRM?

  1. Go to the plugin’s Setup section.
  2. Select WPForms as the form type.
  3. Choose the HubSpot CRM object.
  4. Map WPForms fields to HubSpot CRM fields.
  5. Save the integration.

The same general steps apply for Elementor Forms, Gravity Forms, and Formidable Forms: choose the form type, select the HubSpot CRM object, map fields, and then save.

Can I map custom fields in HubSpot CRM?

Yes, you can map form fields to custom properties in HubSpot CRM where available. This helps organize and segment your data more effectively.

What happens if a submission fails to sync with HubSpot CRM?

Failed submissions are:

  • Recorded in the Logs section
  • Shown with the error message returned by HubSpot
  • Available for manual or bulk resync, where supported

Does this plugin support real-time sync?

Yes. Form entries are sent to HubSpot CRM immediately after submission, subject to API availability and configuration.

Do I need a HubSpot CRM account to use this plugin?

Yes. You need an active HubSpot CRM account to send data from your WordPress site to HubSpot.

Is data transfer secure between WordPress and HubSpot CRM?

The plugin uses:

  • OAuth 2.0 for authentication
  • Communication over HTTPS (provided your site and HubSpot endpoints use HTTPS)

You should ensure your site is configured to use HTTPS for best security.

Is this plugin an alternative to general automation plugins for HubSpot CRM?

Yes. This plugin is built specifically for HubSpot CRM. It connects supported forms directly to HubSpot without an external automation service.

Can I send WordPress form data to HubSpot CRM without an automation service?

Yes. The plugin handles the integration directly on your WordPress site.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • New: redesigned admin – Setup, Logs and Settings (Connections and Notifications), with toasts, empty states and a single-page feel (no full reloads).
  • New: 3-step Add / Edit wizard (form and destination, field mapping, record action and filters) with Test connection, Test run and “Refresh from HubSpot”.
  • New: Logs show success, failed and skipped entries with status counts, filters, paging, the full HubSpot response (including note and attachment results) and resync.
  • New: connections list with Reconnect, rename and delete; a notice with a Re-check button when HubSpot no longer accepts a connection.
  • New: properties are cached for 6 hours per connection, with a Refresh button.
  • Improved: one shared token refresh with a reconnect flag, clear log codes for token problems, and at most one failure e-mail per connection and error type per hour.
  • Improved: attachments from WPForms, Gravity Forms and Elementor are read from the site uploads folder; remote URLs are never fetched.
  • Improved: log times use the site timezone.
  • Fixed: PHP 7.4 compatibility (the plugin used PHP 8-only functions).
  • Fixed: the Logs and Settings screens no longer rely on inline scripts; all texts are translatable.
  • Removed: the review notice, the promotional banner and the “other plugins” tab.
  • New: Record actions: Always add as a new record, Skip if the record exists, Add or update, and Update only.
  • Improved: Skipped entries are logged for filter conditions and for record actions that send nothing, with a clear message.
  • Fixed: Editing and saving an integration no longer drops saved field mappings that the wizard does not display.
  • Fixed: Connecting an account no longer fails to save long access tokens.
  • Existing connections, integrations, mappings, logs and settings are kept.

1.0.17

  • Checked: Tested and confirmed compatible with WordPress 7.1.

1.0.16

  • Fixed: Missing spacing between the add (+) and remove (−) buttons in the field mapping table.

1.0.15

  • Security: Hardened admin AJAX endpoints with proper capability checks across all handlers.
  • Security: Fixed path traversal vulnerability in admin tab routing with strict allowlist validation.
  • Security: Added nonce verification to OAuth callback handler.
  • Security: Fixed conditional nonce bypass in bulk action handler.
  • Security: Replaced innerHTML assignment with DOM-safe escaping to prevent XSS.
  • Security: Improved input sanitization for integer fields.
  • Added: Help dropdown in admin header for quick support access.
  • Added: Deactivation feedback popup.
  • Improved: Minor UI and code quality improvements.
  • Checked: Tested and confirmed compatible with WordPress 7.0.

1.0.14

  • Security: Added ABSPATH check to prevent direct file access across missing files.

1.0.13

  • Fixed: Settings link in Plugins page now uses admin_url() for improved compatibility.
  • Improved: Code hardening with stricter output escaping in admin views.
  • Checked: Tested and confirmed compatible with WordPress 6.9.1.

1.0.12

  • Improved: Readme content clarity and wording for better understanding of supported forms and HubSpot CRM integrations.
  • Updated: Short description to clearly mention support for other form submissions.
  • Improved: Minor UI text refinements across admin pages.

1.0.11

  • Changed: Replaced transient-based account authentication storage with WordPress options for improved reliability.
  • Improved: Account authentication flow stability during OAuth redirects.
  • Improved: Better handling of authentication errors and session recovery.
  • Improved: Data sanitization and validation in the Accounts and Setup pages.
  • Fixed: Edge cases where account data could be lost during browser refresh or delayed redirects.

1.0.10

  • Checked: Plugin tested and confirmed compatible with WordPress 6.9
  • Updated: “Tested up to” value updated to 6.9 in readme.txt

1.0.9

  • Updated: Readme file revised to follow WordPress.org guidelines.
  • Updated: Description, tags, and sections rewritten for clarity and compliance.

1.0.8

  • Changed: Elementor Forms integration flow updated for smoother setup.
  • Improved: Reliability when mapping Elementor form fields.

1.0.7

  • Added: FAQ entry about disabling specific integrations.
  • Fixed: All known error notices reported by WordPress debug logs.
  • Checked: Tested with WordPress 6.8.

1.0.6

  • Fixed: Elementor Forms field-loading issue.

1.0.5

  • Added: Improved validation and sanitization.
  • Fixed: Issue causing a blank page when selecting a list.

1.0.4

  • Added: WordPress 6.8 compatibility.
  • Fixed: Removed unnecessary use of $wpdb->prepare() for static table names.
  • Fixed: i18n issue by removing an empty __() string in get_columns().

1.0.3

  • Verified: Compatibility with WordPress 6.7.2.
  • Updated: Applied recent HubSpot API changes.
  • Refined: User interface adjustments.

1.0.2

  • Added: Step-by-step screenshots in the documentation.

1.0.1

  • Added: Review and feedback section.

1.0.0

  • Initial release with:
    • Support for Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms, WPForms, Elementor Forms, and Formidable Forms.
    • Error logging and resync options for failed submissions.
    • Email notifications for integration failures.
